items.says: Keep the merchant-onboarding achievement under the correct entry and make its figures and context agree.
Move EXPERIENCE above EDUCATION and use the order EXPERIENCE, PROJECTS, EDUCATION, SKILLS.
Remove personal details that are not relevant to a hiring decision.
Describe the chargeback figure as an estimate based on six months of data.
Lead with the $1.1M estimate, shorten its format, and state its roadmap relevance directly.
Add the measured outcome of the onboarding comparison.
Qualify the onboarding result as an observed pilot change unless a controlled comparison supports causation.
Add the unit to the ending figure.
Describe the late-delivery result as a change in the reporting calculation, not as a reduction in actual late deliveries.
Change Cut warehouse pick errors 30% to Cut warehouse pick errors by 30%.
Do not claim that the slotting redesign cut errors unless comparable pre- and post-intervention measurements support that claim.
Use past tense consistently for both actions in this completed role.
Add the business result enabled by the S&OP review and forecast pack.
Show one concrete product or rollout action you owned as Product Lead and clarify the relationship with the two dining halls.
Bring the food-rescue result forward and remove the buried relative clause.
Name the core mechanism of the volunteer process instead of calling it a volunteer shift system.
Remove the repeated weekly cadence from the ending.
Add the result produced by the weekly scheduling sessions.
Do not claim that front-desk staff adopted the changes without evidence of adoption.
State how much the intake form was shortened or what result followed.
Use active voice and place the measured outcome directly after the work performed.
Remove the merchant-onboarding claim from this hospital project or replace it with the actual hospital practicum result.
Remove the merchant-onboarding bullet from the hospital practicum entry.
